subject.title: Improve macOS onboarding UX and gateway setup

question: Should this protected broad macOS onboarding PR be closed or replaced now that current main has the local-Gateway and Crestodian onboarding work, or should the author rebase and repair the remaining pieces?
rationale: The `maintainer` label is a protected workflow signal, and the remaining choice is product/ownership plus security-risk acceptance rather than a narrow automated fix.

options.title: Close or replace with narrow work
options.body: Treat the merged onboarding/Gateway PRs and the open configured-Gateway bug as the canonical paths, then ask for any useful remainder as a fresh narrow PR with proof.

options.title: Require a full rebase and repair
options.body: Keep this PR as the working branch only if a maintainer wants the contributor to rebase onto current main, remove superseded pieces, fix the blockers, and add live macOS proof.

options.title: Accept the branch risk
options.body: A maintainer could intentionally sponsor the current branch direction, but that would require explicit security/auth compatibility review before merge.

recommendation.title: Close or replace with narrow work
recommendation.body: Treat the merged onboarding/Gateway PRs and the open configured-Gateway bug as the canonical paths, then ask for any useful remainder as a fresh narrow PR with proof.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete authored the merged macOS onboarding/Gateway work that now defines the likely replacement path.
